blocking_defects.title: The launch-time freeze-composition check is self-referential: the 'review files' that may differ from the qualified candidate are whatever the FREEZE under verification declares
blocking_defects.detail: GATE.execution states that ready/execute refuse unless `git diff --name-only <candidate> HEAD` equals allowed_freeze_delta, 'which must be exactly FREEZE.json, FREEZE_HASH and the review files', and GATE.freeze_procedure defines the review files as exactly QUALIFICATION_REVIEW.json and QUALIFICATION_REVIEW.md in a new directory review/qualification_rN/. verify_freeze only checks set(allowed_freeze_delta) == {FREEZE.json, FREEZE_HASH} | set(review_files), qualification_review in review_files, and every review file bound, where review_files is read from the same FREEZE.json. It never constrains review_files (number, names, directory under review/, absence at the candidate) and never reads the bound review (verdict, candidate_commit). The r4 test 'a freeze widening its own delta' widens allowed_freeze_delta alone; widening review_files together with it is not tested and passes.

demonstrations.spec_smuggled: Synthetic copy: after make_freeze, SPECIFICATION.md edited; FREEZE.json rewritten with the path appended to review_files and allowed_freeze_delta and its new hash; FREEZE_HASH refreshed; committed. ready PASS.
demonstrations.code_smuggled: Synthetic copy: same with code/k4r1_certificate.py edited to add a marker field to the result. git status empty, ready PASS, execute EXECUTED and the result carries the marker (unqualified code ran), and ready PASS again in a fresh clone of the freeze commit, so re-running from a clean clone, the governance's own check, does not detect it.

blocking_defects.why_blocking: The freeze is the only machine-checked link between the qualified candidate and the code that runs exactly once, and r4 was specifically required to close the second half of Q3 (ready/execute must verify freeze == candidate + review + FREEZE files). As implemented, the verification certifies a premise supplied by the object under verification, so it detects only freezes that are internally inconsistent, not freezes that change the candidate. The natural 'make it pass' response to the refusal 'freeze delta / review files malformed' after a post-freeze edit is exactly this edit, and the result would then survive a fresh-clone ready and a fresh-clone re-execution. The implementation also falls short of the frozen gate text it would be bound to. It cannot be repaired after the freeze.
repair: verify_freeze: require review_files to be exactly two paths <ns>/review/<d>/QUALIFICATION_REVIEW.json and <ns>/review/<d>/QUALIFICATION_REVIEW.md for a single directory name d (no '/', not ending in _REJECTED), both ABSENT at qualified_candidate_commit (`git cat-file -e <cand>:<path>` fails) and present at HEAD; require qualification_review to be the .json one.
verify_freeze: parse the bound review JSON and require verdict == QUALIFICATION_ACCEPTED and candidate_commit == qualified_candidate_commit (closes N21).

Recommended in the same change: compare each bound tracked file's sha256 with the HEAD blob (`git show HEAD:<path>`), as is already done for FREEZE.json (closes N19); use `git diff --no-renames --name-only` (closes N22); refuse ignored entries inside the namespace in launch_gates, or run with `python3 -I -B` in the runbook, and apply the same to make_freeze (closes N20).

Tests: review_files widened with a modified code/spec/gate file (same checkout and fresh clone); review_files with three entries, a wrong name, a directory outside review/, or a path tracked at the candidate; a FREEZE naming a REJECTED review or another candidate; each must be refused, plus a positive fresh-clone control. Add the corresponding harness mutants.

non_blocking_notes.text: Index flags: under `git update-index --assume-unchanged` or `--skip-worktree`, an edited tracked file is invisible to git status. make_freeze binds the edited bytes, and ready/execute then run unqualified code in that checkout (demonstrated). A fresh clone refuses with bound-file drift. Fix: compare bound hashes with HEAD blobs, or refuse if `git ls-files -v` shows lowercase or S flags.

Shadow modules: the script directory code/ is sys.path[0], and the repo .gitignore ignores *.py[cod]. An ignored sourceless code/<stdlib-name>.pyc (or a .py hidden via .git/info/exclude) is imported in place of the stdlib module. After the freeze nothing examines ignored files, and a synthetic code/fractions.pyc ran arbitrary code through ready and execute with git status empty and no committed trace (demonstrated). make_freeze imports json/hashlib before its own ignored check (a garbage code/json.pyc crashed it). `python3 -I` removes the script directory from sys.path (verified under 3.9 and 3.14). Deliberate only.

verify_freeze trusts FREEZE.qualification_verdict and never reads the bound review. A hand-written FREEZE binding a REJECTED review, or a review naming another candidate, passes ready (demonstrated). Folded into the Q4 repair.

`git diff --name-only` uses rename detection by default. A freeze commit that deletes an unbound file outside the namespace whose content is similar to a new review file shows only the new path, and passes ready (demonstrated). Use --no-renames.

GATE says 'exactly once, at the freeze commit', but an empty commit on top of the freeze passes ready. The tree is identical, and executed_at_head records it. The final adjudicator should check that executed_at_head is the freeze commit, or tree-identical to it.

stop_conditions wording, detailed in check 4: (i) state that any existing reservation or result, in any checkout, ends the lineage, that the fresh-clone clause never applies after a reservation has been made anywhere, and that the reservation or result is committed immediately whatever its content (N9 carried); (ii) drop the 'ignored stray file' and 'missing ignored cache' causes, or make ready check them; (iii) say that git status must be empty after the freeze COMMIT; (iv) define 'freeze lineage'.
